Thanks for this fix — the diagnosis and the wording change are correct, and the unit test would fail on current `dev`.

We are going to land the same repair in #2866 and close this PR as a duplicate. Both change `_unreadable_choice_result()` with equivalent guidance (do not retry `mastery_grade` this turn; ask / `mastery_quiz` / skip or repair). #2866 was opened first by the issue author and also covers the `MasteryGradeTool.execute` path plus the blank-answer branch. Please do not merge both; they would conflict.

No changes requested on the code itself. Closing in favor of #2866.
